ios.desc:
Habi is a daily habit tracker, Pomodoro focus timer, and routine planner app that helps you build flexible schedules and overcome procrastination. Connect it directly to your calendar to manage complex projects, track daily chores, or just find a moment of peace.

[ KEY FEATURES ]
• CALENDAR-DRIVEN HABITS: Build routines that actually fit your schedule. Sync events to turn your existing calendar into trackable daily routines.
• POMODORO FOCUS TIMER: Stop multitasking and get deep work done. Beat distraction and manage time blocks using built-in ambient sounds like rain and white noise.
• PROJECTS & TO-DO LISTS: Break big goals into step-by-step productivity checklists to avoid executive dysfunction and overwhelm.
• FLEXIBLE PLANNING: Every day is different. Drag and drop tasks to adapt your daily schedule based on your energy levels and mood.
• SCREEN TIME BLOCKER: Set app limits and digital boundaries to maintain deep work sessions.
• VISUAL COUNTDOWNS: Keep an eye on important dates without the stress. Track deadlines and events right from your home screen.
• CUSTOM iOS WIDGETS: Keep your goals front and center. View your daily streaks and habit progress without opening the app.
• ALL-IN-ONE DASHBOARD: View your habits, calendar events, to-dos, and project lists in one unified view.

[ PRIVATE & ACCESSIBLE ]
Habi is an accessible habit tracker fully supporting iOS features like VoiceOver screen readers, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and Reduce Transparency. Your data is strictly private, securely stored on your device, and backed up via personal iCloud. We never access your data.

Start small. Stay consistent. Change your life.

quotes.text:
hey everyone, i built this habit tracker because my daughter kept forgetting things before basketball practice like her water bottle or sports eyewear.

most habit trackers live separately from calendars, so i built one where habits are driven by calendar events. you can attach checklists to events so calendar events become habits.

this is my first vibe-coded app, built with my wife and daughter. would love any feedback and happy to answer questions.
